impact: A supportive call for PLTR, though it is a smaller broker and the stock is likely to trade with the wider AI selloff into Nvidia earnings.
summary: Phillip Securities raised its Palantir price target to $248 from $215 and kept a Buy rating, citing strong third-quarter results; the target implies about 48% upside from the last close of $167.99.
title: Phillip Securities lifts Palantir target to $248 from $215, keeps Buy
